stem: One irrigation zone repeatedly shows clogged emitters beyond the routine correction allowed by procedure. What should Technician I do?
choices: Disassemble the protected irrigation components to find the obstruction because the fault is recurring.
Increase system pressure above the normal work-order setting to clear the emitters.
Stop recording repeated clogs after the first event because the issue is already known.
Document the recurrence, affected zone and permitted checks completed, then escalate the unresolved delivery/equipment fault.
rationale: A recurring emitter problem is evidence of an unresolved system condition. Technician I should preserve that pattern and escalate after completing only the authorized checks. Disassembly, pressure changes, or stopping documentation can hide the severity of the problem or exceed role authority.
